description:
FileNet Administrator/Developer 
 

 On behalf of our client, Procom Services is searching for a FileNet Administrator/Developer for a contract opportunity in New York, NY.
 

 FileNet Administrator/Developer Job Details 
 

 Work as FileNet system administrator to plan, coordinate, and implement major system upgrades, fix packs, and patches to the FileNet servers. Assist with migrating large volumes of Image Services documents to the FileNet platform and performing reconciliation reporting. Monitor systems, diagnose issues, implement fixes, and provide mission critical support. Perform application and system administration for platforms that include document class maintenance, security maintenance, document recovery, and repository maintenance.
 

 FileNet Administrator/Developer Mandatory Skills 
 

 Experience as FileNet system administrator or developer.
 FileNet certification is a plus. 
 Vb.net programming familiarity is a plus.
 SQL server database experience is a plus.
 

 FileNet Administrator/Developer Start Date 
 

 ASAP
 

 FileNet Administrator/Developer Assignment Length 
 

 12+ months


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
